title: Blank Check
statement: Implement `solve(text)`. Return 1 when the stripped text is empty, and 0 otherwise. This is a pure function of the string. It does not need an instance.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A static check of a string does not read instance state.

editorial: A static check of a string does not read instance state. Making it a method that requires self forces the caller to build an object for a question about text. The function here is that check and nothing else.
reference_solution:
def solve(text):
    return 1 if not text.strip() else 0
